newsitem.title: USA: US weekly corn, cotton exports at '96/97 high-USDA.
newsitem.headline: US weekly corn, cotton exports at '96/97 high-USDA.

text.p: U.S. corn and upland cotton exports sales during the week ending Jan 23 were the highest yet for the 1996-97 marketing year, Agriculture Department said Thursday.
Net corn sales of 1,285,400 tonnes were two percent above the preceding week but 80 percent above the four-week average.
Net upland cotton sales of 257,200 running bales were 20 percent higher than the previous week and 64 percent above the four-week average.
Nonetheless, corn and upland cotton exports lagged behind the pace set in 1995-96.
